name: How long does it take to receive a repair estimate after an on-site visit?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to receive a repair estimate after an on-site visit?

acceptedAnswer.text: After an on-site visit to your property in the Bay Area, City Dweller, LLC typically provides a detailed repair estimate within 3 to 5 business days. The exact timeframe can vary depending on the complexity of the repair and the need to gather quotes for specialized materials or services. We prioritize accuracy and thoroughness to ensure your estimate is comprehensive and reliable, giving you a clear picture of your project.
